description: Pick camping cookware by material, size and heat source, from titanium pots for backpackers to cast iron for campfires and sets for family car camping.
directAnswer: Match material to how you cook: hard-anodized aluminum for all-round car camping, titanium for ultralight boiling, cast iron for open fire and stainless for durability or induction. Size pots to about 1 liter per person.
